Schedules, their next due times and their runs.

## List schedules

`GET /v1/schedules` (SDK method `listSchedules`)

The organisation's schedules the caller may see, a page at a time. A project's schedules are listed only to those with the viewer role on it.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | [ScheduleKind](/api/reference/types/#schedulekind) | no | What runs. A `task` starts a session with its payload `{ "agentId"?, "prompt" }` and sends the prompt exactly as written; a `check` runs its payload (a command line or an argument list) with no model. |
| `status` | [ScheduleStatus](/api/reference/types/#schedulestatus) | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (minimum 1, maximum 1000) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SchedulePage](/api/reference/types/#schedulepage) (`application/json`). A page of schedules.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create a schedule

`POST /v1/schedules` (SDK method `createSchedule`)

Exactly one of `at` (a one-off) and `repeat`. A task's runs each start a session, in the schedule's project (the default project for one owned by the organisation or a user), running the payload's agent with its prompt sent exactly as written. Agents may not create schedules. Needs the operator role on a project-owned schedule's project.

**Body**: [CreateScheduleBody](/api/reference/types/#createschedulebody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Schedule](/api/reference/types/#schedule) (`application/json`). The new schedule, with its first due time.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change a schedule

`PATCH /v1/schedules/{scheduleId}` (SDK method `updateSchedule`)

Changes the fields given and works out the next due time again. A change that leaves the schedule never due again ends it.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateScheduleBody](/api/reference/types/#updateschedulebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Schedule](/api/reference/types/#schedule) (`application/json`). The schedule as changed.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## End a schedule

`DELETE /v1/schedules/{scheduleId}` (SDK method `deleteSchedule`)

Ends the schedule for good: nothing more runs. It stays listed, as `ended`, with its run history and the sessions its runs started. Ending an ended schedule does nothing.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Schedule](/api/reference/types/#schedule) (`application/json`). The ended schedule.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Pause a schedule

`POST /v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/pause` (SDK method `pauseSchedule`)

Nothing runs while it is paused.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Schedule](/api/reference/types/#schedule) (`application/json`). The paused schedule.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Resume a paused schedule

`POST /v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/resume` (SDK method `resumeSchedule`)

Runs from the next due time after now; the paused time is not made up.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Schedule](/api/reference/types/#schedule) (`application/json`). The resumed schedule, with its next due time.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List a schedule's runs

`GET /v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/runs` (SDK method `listScheduleRuns`)

The run history, a page at a time: each occurrence's status and times, and its result. A task's result names the session it started (`sessionId`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduleId` | string | yes | The schedule's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (minimum 1, maximum 500) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [OccurrencePage](/api/reference/types/#occurrencepage) (`application/json`). A page of runs.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
